## Glyphling 0.8.1

Download `Glyphling-Setup-0.8.1.exe` below and run it. It updates an existing installation in place.

### Changed
- **Crisp circle at every resolution**: dots are hard-edged and the digits, letters, eyes and strokes are redrawn for the chosen resolution instead of being scaled, so 1024 and 2048 points no longer look blurry.
- **Smooth track changes**: title, artist and up-next fade out and in, the new cover enters with a clockwise sweep with a red edge, and the visualizer dips and comes back.
- Includes everything from 0.8.0: circle resolution, 12/24 hour clock, °C/°F, finer volume, real covers at any resolution.

The setup is not signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch ("More info" → "Run anyway").
